Working in the Storm Explorer

All documents will start with a storm model in them, yours included. If you want you can delete it, or you can add model to it. Make new documents using the File menu by choosing New or Make a Copy if you want to reuse pieces of your existing work.

If you want a document to appear in the Daily Updates tab, you'll need to publish it. Publishing is a choice on the File menu. Your published documents will show up as thumbnails.
